subcategory_text: The purposes for the data actions are inventoried.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-15 (Security and Privacy Groups and Associations)
GDPR Art. 5(1)(b) (Purpose limitation), Art. 6 (Lawfulness of processing)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.AM-03 (data flow mapping)
implementation_examples: Document the stated purposes for each data action, consistent with the privacy notice and the records of processing activities
Detect and resolve discrepancies between stated purpose, legal basis, and actual processing
Use the purpose inventory as the reference to detect purpose creep over time
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a purposes inventory exists and is aligned with the privacy notice
Determine whether each purpose maps to a documented legal basis
Determine whether the purposes inventory detects purpose-creep conditions
Determine whether purposes are re-validated during change management
